question: Who among the following Indian cricketers bowled 14 overs with a bandage around his fractured jaw against the West Indies at Antigua in 2002?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Kumble**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anil Kumble **bowled 14 overs with a bandage around his fractured jaw against the West Indies at Antigua in 2002.
 
• It was the fourth test match of the series in **Antigua Recreation Ground West Indies**.
 
• He was struck on his jaw by a West Indies bowler **Mervyn Dillon **while batting.
 
• He took the wicked of Brian Lara while bowling with a broken Jaw.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The match was **drawn.**
 
• **Anil Kumble **is also known as **Jumbo.**
 
• He is also a former **coach, captain of the Indian cricket team and commentator.**
 
• He had a carrier of **18 years in international cricket**.
 
• He received a number of awards like the **Arjuna award, Wisden Cricketer of the year award in 1996, Padma Shri, and ICC cricket Hall of fame in the year 2015.**
